+// RangeKeysOnly returns metadata for live keys without reading values from
+// the backend. When total counting is disabled, scanning stops at the limit.
+func (ti *treeIndex) RangeKeysOnly(key, end []byte, atRev int64, limit int, withTotalCount bool) (kvs []*mvccpb.KeyValue, total int) {
+	ti.RLock()
+	defer ti.RUnlock()
+
+	visit := func(ki *keyIndex) bool {
+		modified, created, ver, err := ki.get(ti.lg, atRev)
+		if err != nil {
+			return true
+		}
+		if limit > 0 && len(kvs) >= limit && !withTotalCount {
+			return false
+		}
+		if limit <= 0 || len(kvs) < limit {
+			kvs = append(kvs, &mvccpb.KeyValue{
+				Key:            ki.key,
+				CreateRevision: created.Main,
+				ModRevision:    modified.Main,
+				Version:        ver,
+			})
+		}
+		total++
+		return true
+	}
+
+	if end == nil {
+		if ki := ti.keyIndex(&keyIndex{key: key}); ki != nil {
+			visit(ki)
+		}
+		return kvs, total
+	}
+	ti.unsafeVisit(key, end, visit)
+	return kvs, total
+}
